p_a31a016ed7.sentence: “And I almost lost my trust in you,” his friend replied.
p_a31a016ed7.prev: “I almost left you to die,” Melos said softly.
p_a31a016ed7.next: The day’s last light touched the walls as they held each other.

p_6214e61d2c.sentence: “How can someone earn trust like this?”
p_6214e61d2c.prev: “Put down the sword and free both men,” he finally said.

p_4333ffd345.sentence: “Give me three days to see my sister get married, and I’ll come back.”
p_4333ffd345.next: With a smile, the ruler said, “Your friend stays here.

p_7af80f8e1f.sentence: Return late, and he’ll die in your place.”

p_b78ee06641.sentence: Melos stepped back, ran forward, and jumped into the flood.
p_b78ee06641.prev: The bridge was missing, and rain had made the water brown and wild.
p_b78ee06641.next: The water pulled him down, but he struggled toward the light.

p_3f2d515e5a.sentence: He fell beside a rock and tried to get up.
